failures.trigger: Physical quote request begins before the exact market_reference_allowed transition.

failures.fail_closed: Route specialist_required under v0.5 alpha and do not create market equity.

failures.trigger: An old, replaced, consumed, or ambiguous v4 authorization begins another market request.

failures.trigger: Calendar coverage is guessed, incomplete, mismatched to the exchange, or returns a session after cutoff or before completion.

failures.verification: Calendar identity, holiday/weekend, cutoff, and incomplete-session tests.

failures.trigger: An invalid raw response is promoted, returned, or persisted instead of quarantined by hash.

failures.verification: Response mutation, raw-byte absence, quarantine-hash, and no-writer tests.

failures.trigger: A caller supplies or subclasses a Provider, registry, parser, or calendar outside the component-lock authority.

failures.verification: Exact-class, bound-method, registry-hash, and signature tests.

failures.trigger: Calendar data is caller-selected, incomplete, outside 2026 XNYS/XNAS coverage, or hash-mismatched.

failures.verification: Independent session oracle, holiday, DST, early-close, coverage, and SHA tests.

failures.verification: Security proposal, closure, review-decision, and replay tests.

failures.trigger: Quote text is noncanonical, nonfinite, nonpositive, exponential, localized, signed, or zero-padded.

failures.verification: Canonical Decimal adversarial matrix.

failures.verification: Canonical-decimal, exact-product, unit, and CalculationResult tests.

failures.verification: Share-date, basis-kind, corporate-action, and root-overlap tests.

failures.verification: Closure ordering, fingerprint mutation, and duplicate-consumption tests.

failures.trigger: The price-blind artifact, component lock, security compilation, governed access result, issuer, cutoff, or security does not replay exactly.

failures.verification: Magnitude, date, concept, security, and cumulative-grain conflict cases.

failures.verification: Option, warrant, convertible, exact-group, arithmetic, and chain tests.

failures.trigger: Recursive current-share lineage contains a dangling edge, cycle, future/cross-issuer/cross-security evidence, Bundle-closure escape, or a hidden numeric root.

failures.trigger: Phase 5E-2B.1-2A exposes a builder, compiler, writer, persistence, publication, scoring, valuation, report, PDF, Publisher, network, market-evidence, Snapshot, request, or kernel-execution capability, or modifies the existing current-share production path.

failures.fail_closed: Re-derive authority from the exact full PriceBlindFreezeCompilationResult and the same validated scoped ContractGraph used by CurrentShareBundleEvidenceClosure; require current component lock, graph-owned Bundle/RunManifest, one unique current unsuperseded adjacent v1-v4 Handoff run, unique typed review arrays with exact binding cardinality, every consumption root/key/identity to resolve to its reviewed binding, and only the exact registered option-bridge deduction for each excluded root, plus every root Fact/formal Source/Candidate/named-human Decision/Claim; reject the transition reconciliation and all dependent numeric lineage.
failures.verification: Claim-root concept, canonical-parent, synchronized artifact-and-Handoff resign, duplicate typed identity, duplicate/unique-unexpected/unbound-root consumption, superseded and two-active authorization runs, graph-external root, cross-graph transplant, missing graph-owned review chain, reviewed-key, multi-root lineage, and one-to-one review tests.

failures.trigger: A reviewed Candidate support or counterevidence object, or any SourceDocument content fingerprint, is omitted from or changed inside the recursive extension closure.
failures.fail_closed: Recompute the exact transitive extension and source closure; reject missing, extra, or drifted objects.
failures.verification: Counterevidence truncation and source-content mutation tests.

failures.verification: Reversed member/source/candidate/decision order metamorphic test.

failures.trigger: A Phase 5C economic-claim binding omits its Candidate or named-human ReviewDecision, violates the confirmed/blocked review-chain shape, or reuses one typed Candidate, ReviewDecision, or Claim while set-based comparison hides excess binding cardinality.

failures.verification: Duplicate-category, generic/reused N/A chain, scope, temporal, reviewer, evidence-hash, Claim-projection, source-closure, and shared-support positive-control tests.

failures.trigger: A frozen Phase 5C option-or-dilution authority is generalized to convertible or warrant claims, or duplicate typed SourceDocuments or security-evidence identities are hidden by set comparison.

failures.verification: Option positive control, convertible/warrant specialist routing, outer-closure bypass, duplicate Bundle SourceDocument, and duplicate security-evidence identity tests.

failures.trigger: Coverage accepts a typed SourceDocument, receipt, zero/observed/support/counterevidence Fact, Candidate, Decision, or Claim with a graph-owned ID but different bytes; accepts non-Fact or reused binding identity; uses support or counterevidence after the Candidate date; permits a Candidate before the covered period end; or reviews after the data cutoff.

failures.verification: Pre-period Candidate, post-cutoff review, post-Candidate support/counterevidence Fact/source, non-Fact binding, cross-polarity binding reuse, zero/source byte substitution, and full recursive typed-parity probes.

failures.trigger: A Claim transition carries a Fact period or SourceDocument publication after its Candidate or data cutoff, a post-cutoff or inexact Candidate/Decision/Claim chain, or any affected/remaining/evidence Fact, source, Claim, Candidate, or Decision has the same graph ID but different bytes.
failures.fail_closed: Require every direct transition evidence Fact and formal source to be no later than its Candidate, require the exact issuer-wide Candidate-to-named-human-Decision-to-Claim projection through cutoff, and byte-bind every typed transition object to the graph-owned Bundle closure.
failures.verification: Future transition Fact/source, future transition review, and same-ID/different-Decision-byte final-closure tests.

failures.trigger: Materialization code identity, adversarial expected outcomes, test totals, skips, failures, or node IDs are accepted from mutable semantic labels or self-reported test manifests without byte-level and independent runtime replay.

failures.verification: Source-byte mutation, case-expected drift, empty-test marker, exact node-ID hash, independent JUnit count, skip, failure, and manifest-disagreement tests.

failures.trigger: Any same-repository PR is skipped by branch-name control flow or changes the pending acceptance trust root outside its reserved closeout; an acceptance PR targets a non-main or foreign base, contains more than one direct commit, changes beyond the exact two governance files, contains open, duplicate-key, non-finite, noncanonical, bool-as-integer, or float-as-integer evidence JSON, executes candidate code, gains secrets, accepts incomplete pagination, uses a wrong workflow file/ref/ID/state, accepts a permissive or cancelling JUnit grammar, omits audited-tree evidence, or produces a merged-main tree different from its acceptance head.

Pin exact Action/runtime and workflow file/ref/ID/name/active state; require one direct non-merge closeout commit; stable total-count-bound pagination; exact implementation and acceptance associations; exactly one current successful acceptance run; closed typed canonical four-file evidence; thirteen evidence-bearing checks; the exact pytest testsuites-to-property grammar with zero failures, errors, and skips; a complete audited file set; and merged-main tree equality before provenance replay.

failures.verification: Canonical conflicting-byte, synchronized-binding rewrite, deterministic idempotent materialization, and output namespace-collision adversarial graphs.

failures.verification: Two-by-two-by-two review-chain construction is rejected while the exact one-to-one control passes.

failures.verification: Pending/accepted state tests, malformed closeout, legacy no-op verifier, gate-byte drift, unauthorized branch, exact 2B implementation diff, and exact 2B acceptance-only diff.
